subject: Graceband (retreat) clause request — ACME pilot: limited opt-out & credits
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Tom Hargreaves <tom.hargreaves@acmehealth.com>
Cc: procurement@acmehealth.com
Date: Thu, 10 May 2028 09:12:00 +0000
Subject: Request: graceband (retreat) clause for ACME pilot — limited opt-out / credit proposal

Team,

ACME's procurement asked this morning for the ability to reduce committed capacity mid-pilot under a defined "graceband" with a limited opt-out. High level: they want a formal path to downscale the monthly commit to 50% after 60 days if average utilization is below 40% for the prior 30-day window, with a partial credit back for unused committed tokens and a one-time administrative fee rather than the full early-termination penalty.

Why it matters: ACME is a strategic healthcare pilot (integration with their triage flow). They signed an initial 6-month commit intended to accelerate adoption, but they want flexibility to avoid being stuck on a high commit if usage doesn't ramp. If we don't offer something softer they will walk. They are asking for:
- a 60-day review window;
- ability to downscale to 50% of committed capacity ("retreat") with credits pro-rated for the remaining period;
- a 10% admin fee (instead of 25% termination fee) if they exercise retreat only once during the 6-month term;
- an opt-out trigger tied to a utilization metric (below 40% utilization for prior 30 days).

I attached a one-page summary (ACME_graceband_summary.pdf) with proposed language for a "Graceband / Retreat" clause. Can we get executive sign-off on the principle and guardrails below? I'm routing to Deal Desk (Marissa) for redline to the main SOW and to Markus / Rishi for exec clearance.

Proposed guardrails (suggested):
- Single-use opt-out per 6-month commitment period;
- Credit cap: up to 40% of remaining committed spend, applied as a one-time credit in the next invoice cycle;
- No change to data residency or security commitments;
- Legal to approve final wording and ensure no precedent for future enterprise terms without explicit approval.

Requested ask:
1) Exec approval in principle (Markus / Rishi) for the limited opt-out + credit approach;
2) Deal desk redline to incorporate into the pilot SOW;
3) If approved, I'll confirm with ACME and schedule DocuSign.

Thanks — I can be flexible on the exact credit %, but we should avoid an open-ended opt-out.

Best,
Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Sr. Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: ACME_graceband_summary.pdf (1 page)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Tom Hargreaves <tom.hargreaves@acmehealth.com>, procurement@acmehealth.com
Date: Fri, 11 May 2028 10:30:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Request: graceband (retreat) clause for ACME pilot — limited opt-out / credit proposal

Sofia — thanks for the summary and timely escalation. I reviewed ACME's ask and drafted a redline that keeps the spirit of the request while protecting our economics.

Key edits I propose (redline attached: deal-desk-redline-v1.docx):
- Credit calculation: pro-rated unused commitment up to 35% (not 40%) of remaining committed spend;
- Administrative fee: flat 12% of remaining committed value if retreat is exercised;
- Retreat can only be invoked once per 6-month period, and cannot be used in the first 45 days to prevent gaming;
- Require 30 days' notice and usage proof (dashboard export) to trigger the retreat;
- Make the retreat non-precedential and subject to internal Deal Desk approval for future renewals.

If Markus / Rishi are comfortable with the numbers above, I'll incorporate into the SOW and loop Legal for final language.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Deal Desk
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: deal-desk-redline-v1.docx]

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 12 May 2028 08:45:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Request: graceband (retreat) clause for ACME pilot — limited opt-out / credit proposal

Thanks — I read the summary and Marissa's redline. I'm ok to approve the retreat mechanism in principle with these constraints:
- Cap the credit at 35% as Marissa suggested;
- Administrative fee no lower than 12%;
- Single-use opt-out per 6-month term and a 45-day minimum wait before invocation;
- Require Deal Desk and Finance sign-off on the exact credit calculation before DocuSign;
- Legal must add non-precedent language and an explicit clause preventing rolling this into enterprise renewals without executive approval.

I don't want to set open precedent — this is a one-off concession to secure the pilot. If that aligns with Deal Desk, greenlight to proceed to Legal and then to ACME.

Markus
Markus Klein
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: markus_approval_note.txt]

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Hargreaves <tom.hargreaves@acmehealth.com>, procurement@acmehealth.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 12 May 2028 16:20:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Request: graceband (retreat) clause for ACME pilot — limited opt-out / credit proposal

Tom / procurement team — quick update: Markus and Deal Desk have approved a limited "Graceband / Retreat" path for the pilot, subject to final Legal and Finance sign-off. High level of the agreed approach:

- Single-use retreat available after day 45, with a 30-day notice and evidence of usage < 40% over prior 30 days;
- Credit: pro-rated unused commitment up to 35% of remaining committed spend;
- Administrative fee: 12% of remaining committed value when retreat is exercised;
- Retreat reduces committed capacity to 50% for the remainder of the 6-month pilot;
- Clause will include explicit non-precedent language.

Next steps: Marissa will incorporate the redline into the SOW and route to Legal/Finance for final approval. I will share the redline and the DocuSign link once Legal signs off. For transparency I've added a shared folder with the redline and the summary: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-ACME-graceband.

Tom — is ACME comfortable with the single-use restriction and the 12% administrative fee? If yes, we'll fast-track to Legal and DocuSign.

Appreciate the quick partnership — I think this preserves our economics while giving ACME a safe path to reduce risk.

Best,
Sofia
Sr. Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
